controls.name: SELECT
controls.STEPS: Move the cursor. SEL held: wrap the pattern
controls.PLAY: Stopped: pick a pad. EDIT held: move the pattern along (the others shift)

controls.name: PRESETS
controls.STEPS: Pick a pattern (cued while it plays)
controls.PLAY: Pick a pattern (cued while it plays)

controls.name: GLO
controls.STEPS: Manual. After a twist of the knobs: what that page does
controls.PLAY: Manual. After a twist of the knobs: what that page does

controls.name: PLAY
controls.STEPS: Start, stop: loops the pattern you are on
controls.PLAY: Start, stop: plays the chain from its first pattern, round and round

controls.name: ENV
controls.STEPS: Accent on the step. Held: write with one

controls.name: SEL
controls.STEPS: Tap: slide on the step. Held: write with a slide
controls.PLAY: Stopped, hold: copy the pattern to the first empty pad

controls.name: EDIT
controls.PLAY: Tap: clear what is lined up (and the chain, when stopped). Held + SELECT: move the pattern

controls.name: OCT-/OCT+
controls.PLAY: Stopped: OCT+ adds the pattern to the chain, OCT- takes the last one off

controls.name: GLO + HOME
controls.STEPS: Menu: Factory Reset, Roll The Dice, MIDI Clock, Bluetooth

pages: how far each note sweeps it
how long a normal note's sweep takes
the oscillator pushed into the filter: all the way down, it goes silent
how long an accent's sweep takes
a soft start to each note
how long each note lasts: all the way up, it holds
a square an octave down: off, low, mid, high (a switch)
the Devil Fish switch: sweep, sweep + hi res, no sweep + hi res (a switch)
keeps the low end when it sings (a switch)
a slow wander, like old gear (a switch)
tips: Hold SEL and turn SELECT to wrap the pattern round: the steps slide along and come back at the other end
Hold ENV or SEL while you press a key to write the note with an accent or a slide
PLAY view: pick a pattern and press OCT+ to add it to the chain; PLAY plays the chain, round and round (in STEPS it loops one pattern). While it plays, a white key lines up a pattern
Pages 5 and 6 of the knobs are the switches, drawn as switches: turn a knob right to flip one up

Hold SEL on a project in the project list to copy it into the first free spot (project 1 is a locked demo, KOROBEINIKI), hold EDIT to start it over (on the demo: delete it, then project 1 is yours; Restore Demos in the menu brings it back when project 1 is empty)
Send MIDI clock and the FM-1 follows it. The tempo turns cyan
GLO + HOME is the menu. MIDI Clock sends the clock or follows one (Off, Send, Follow). Roll The Dice fills every pattern of every project with random stuff: hold OCT+ to confirm
